name: Krah
source:
What will happen to a person if the events in his life repeat themselves over and over again?
What will happen to his psyche if he watches the same everyday camp scenes without a hint of the slightest change?
Obviously, nothing good. Madness, you will say. And, perhaps, I agree with you. After all, the once heaven on earth, in which our protagonist found himself, turned out to be a living hell for him in the end. And he, in complete hopelessness and despair, tries to exist within these frameworks of his new "life". But at some point, everything changes dramatically and not for the better for him. But what could be worse than his current predicament? Ruin. Absolute ruin of his life.
translation:
如果一个人一生中的事件一遍又一遍地重演，他会发生什么？
如果他每天都看到同样的营地场景，没有丝毫变化，他的心灵会发生什么变化？
显然，没有什么好的。疯狂，你会说。也许，我同意你的观点。毕竟，我们的主角发现自己曾经身处的人间天堂，最终却变成了人间地狱。而他，在完全的绝望和绝望中，试图在他的新“生活”的这些框架内生存。但在某个时刻，一切都发生了巨大的变化，而且对他来说并没有变得更好。但还有什么比他目前的困境更糟糕的呢？废墟。彻底毁了他的一生。
